entity.summary: Gibraltar-based centralized digital asset exchange operated within the GSX Group. GBX opened public trading in July 2018, later received a Gibraltar DLT licence, and was sold to Mine Digital in January 2021; the GBX-DAX platform and customer accounts were then closed rather than continued under the GBX identity.
entity.notes: HEI models the 2021-01-29 terminal state as acquired because GSX Group completed the sale of GBX to Mine Digital on that date. First-party material also states that Mine Digital would not continue the GBX banner or platform technology and that GBX-DAX and customer accounts closed. Consistent with the existing Mine Digital record, no predecessor/successor lineage edge is created: this was an acquisition followed by closure of the GBX exchange identity, not a direct rebrand or platform continuation. The currently reachable gbx.global domain is treated as repurposed because it serves historical/informational material rather than an operating GBX exchange service.

events.title: GBX Digital Asset Exchange opened to public trading
events.description: Gibraltar Blockchain Exchange officially launched its Digital Asset Exchange to the public, offering cryptocurrency trading and fiat onboarding to KYC-approved customers.
events.notes: The exact public launch date is supported by contemporaneous reporting published on 2018-07-23.

events.title: GBX received a Gibraltar DLT licence
events.description: The Gibraltar Financial Services Commission awarded GBX a full Distributed Ledger Technology licence after completion of its application process.
events.notes: The Government of Gibraltar press release is dated 2018-11-26 and states that the licence was awarded on 2018-11-22.

events.title: GBX sale and platform closure schedule announced
events.description: GSX Group announced the sale of GBX to Mine Digital and a staged wind-down: deposits and new registrations would stop, trading would cease on 2021-01-20, and GBX-DAX withdrawals and customer accounts would close on 2021-01-29.
events.notes: This is the announcement event. HEI does not mark the exchange terminal until the documented sale completion and closure on 2021-01-29.

events.title: Mine Digital acquired GBX and GBX-DAX closed
events.description: GSX Group completed the sale of GBX to Mine Digital. On the same date GBX-DAX closed, withdrawals were halted, customer accounts were closed, and remaining eligible customer balances entered the Mine Digital transition process.
events.notes: This is the terminal acquisition marker for the GBX identity. No successor edge is created because Mine Digital used its own platform and did not continue operations under the GBX banner.

evidence.title: Gibraltar Blockchain Exchange officially launches to the public
evidence.notes: Contemporaneous report states that GBX underwent its official full-scale launch on 2018-07-23 and opened the exchange to the public.

evidence.title: Gibraltar Blockchain Exchange Awarded Licence by Gibraltar Financial Services Commission
evidence.notes: Government press release identifies GBX as the token sale platform and Digital Asset Exchange subsidiary of GSX and states it was awarded a full GFSC DLT licence on 2018-11-22.

evidence.title: Global Blockchain Exchange (GBX) – Sale to Mine Digital
evidence.notes: First-party notice announces the sale to Mine Digital and the staged closure schedule, including trading cessation and the 2021-01-29 closure of GBX-DAX, withdrawals, and customer accounts.

evidence.title: Global Blockchain Exchange (GBX) Completes Sale Process to Mine Digital
evidence.notes: First-party completion notice confirms the sale to Mine Digital and states that GBX-DAX was closed, withdrawals halted, customer accounts closed, and remaining balances transferred into the Mine Digital transition process.
